a11y/aria-labels: returns no checks when the page has no document root; nothing to judge
a11y/svg-img-alt: returns no checks when there is no svg with role="img" in scope
integrity/kit-signature: emits a check only when a known kit signature matches; a clean page has none
mobile/input-zoom: returns no checks when the page has no focusable input field in scope
schema/website-search: returns no checks when the page declares no WebSite schema
security/password-form-get: returns no checks when the page has no password form in scope
